rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site aggregated reference cohort from 6 independent sites (AOMIC PIOP2, Duke Neurogenetics Study, HCP Development, HCP Young Adult, UK Biobank, MIND-Set).
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "We collated a large reference sample from 6 independent sites for whom high quality fMRI data for the EFMT are available: AOMIC PIOP2, Duke Neurogenetics Study, HCP Development, HCP Young Adult (1200 release), UK Biobank, and the MIND-Set cohort"

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference cohort includes established public datasets HCP and UK Biobank.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "including the UK Biobank 11 , the Human Connectome Project (HCP) 12,13 , HCP Development 14"

rci3_epd_name.detail: HCP Young Adult and HCP Development; UK Biobank.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "including the UK Biobank 11 , the Human Connectome Project (HCP) 12,13 , HCP Development 14"

rci5_n.detail: Overall reference cohort across six sites; same participants used to build both contrasts' normative models.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "we estimated normative models of EFMT-related BOLD activation for the face>shapes and faces>baseline contrast using data from 7728 individuals across the lifespan."
rci5_n.location: Savage2024.pdf.md: Results / Fitting reference normative models

rci6_sex.detail: Overall reference cohort; female counts summed across six reference sites from Table 1; male_n inferred from total N=7728.

rci7_age.detail: Overall reference cohort; weighted mean and pooled SD computed from site-level age statistics in Table 1 across six reference sites; age in years.
